problems.problem:
Let $a_n>0$ for $n\ge1$. Consider the right triangles $\triangle A_0A_1A_2,\triangle A_0A_2A_3,\ldots,\triangle A_0A_{n-1}A_n,\ldots$ as follows. For every $n\ge2$, the hypotenuse $A_0A_n$ of $\triangle A_0A_{n-1}A_n$ is a leg of $\triangle A_0A_nA_{n+1}$, with right angle $\angle A_0A_nA_{n+1}$; the vertices $A_{n-1}$ and $A_{n+1}$ lie on opposite sides of the line $A_0A_n$; and $|A_{n-1}A_n|=a_n$ for all $n\ge1$. Is it possible that the set $\{A_n:n\ge0\}$ is unbounded but the series $\sum_{n=2}^{\infty}m(\angle A_{n-1}A_0A_n)$ converges? Here $m(\angle ABC)$ denotes the measure of the angle $ABC$. A set in the plane is bounded if it is contained in some disk.

Consider $A \in \mathcal{M}_{2020}(\mathbb{C})$ such that $$A + A^\times = I_{2020},\qquad A\cdot A^\times = I_{2020}, \tag{1}$$ where $A^\times$ is the adjugate matrix of $A$, i.e., the matrix whose elements are $a_{ij} = (-1)^{i+j}d_{ji}$, where $d_{ji}$ is the determinant obtained from $A$, eliminating the line $j$ and the column $i$.

Find the maximum number of matrices verifying (1) such that any two of them are not similar.
problems.verification_method: Official wording transcribed from the official contest paper and compared visually, formula by formula (2026-10-13)

problems.problem:
Let $k > 1$ be a real number. Calculate:

(a) $$L = \lim_{n\to\infty}\int_0^1\left(\frac{k}{\sqrt[n]{x} + k - 1}\right)^n\mathrm{d}x.$$

(b) $$\lim_{n\to\infty}n\left[L - \int_0^1\left(\frac{k}{\sqrt[n]{x} + k - 1}\right)^n\mathrm{d}x\right].$$
problems.verification_method: Official wording transcribed from the official contest paper and compared visually, formula by formula (2026-10-13)

problems.problem:
Consider $0 < a < T$, $D = \mathbb{R}\setminus\{kT + a \mid k \in \mathbb{Z}\}$, and let $f\colon D \to \mathbb{R}$ a $T$-periodic and differentiable function which satisfies $f' > 1$ on $(0,a)$ and $$f(0) = 0,\quad \lim_{\substack{x\to a\\ x<a}}f(x) = +\infty\quad\text{and}\quad \lim_{\substack{x\to a\\ x<a}}\frac{f'(x)}{f^2(x)} = 1.$$

(a) Prove that for every $n \in \mathbb{N}^*$, the equation $f(x) = x$ has a unique solution in the interval $(nT, nT + a)$, denoted $x_n$.

(b) Let $y_n = nT + a - x_n$ and $z_n = \int_0^{y_n}f(x)\,dx$. Prove that $\lim_{n\to\infty}y_n = 0$ and study the convergence of the series $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}y_n$ and $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}z_n$.
problems.verification_method: Official wording transcribed from the official contest paper and compared visually, formula by formula (2026-10-13)

problems.problem: Let $f:[0,1]\to\mathbb R$ be continuous and increasing with $\lim_{x\to0^+}f(x)/x=1$. (a) Prove that $x_n=\sum_{k=1}^n f(1/k)-\int_1^n f(1/x)\,dx$ converges. (b) Find $\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=n+1}^{2021n}f(1/k)$.

b) Calculate $\lim_{n\to\infty}\dfrac{n}{\ln n}(2 - x_n)$.
